title: Özay Öztürk
text:
You should always use common sense if you do applied statistics. First rule of the game.


In survival analysis we are doing kitchen statistics, not cozy stuff anymore.


There was a smart guy Akaike, he invented something and named it AIC. Later he invented something again but A was gone so he called it BIC.


Rejecting What you want is a dangerous game.


In real life you dont care about the statistical result, looking with your eyes is better.


This is the so called partial Likelihood for Cox regression which is not a likelihood at all.


Did you consider numerical maximization instead of EM ?


The EM algorithm is very important and will follow you in your hidden Markov models lecture.


17 years of research, but i never ever implemented or used the EM algorithm for hidden Markov models.


A phase-type distribution is the distribution of a killing time in a finite-state Markov chain.
